title: Partitioning Into Minimum Number Of Deci-Binary Numbers
goal: Find the minimum number of decimal numbers with only zero and one digits that sum to n.
strategy: Each addend can contribute at most one at any decimal position. The maximum digit supplies a lower bound and that many nested digit layers attain it.
